title: React Interview Notes
description: JS Essentials + React revision: short question, short answer, and syntax when useful.

notes.question: JavaScript mein variable kya hota hai?
notes.answer: Variable naam wala box hai jisme value store karte ho — number, string, boolean, array, object, wagaira. React seekhne se pehle variables clear hona zaroori hai.

notes.question: if / else kab use hota hai?
notes.answer: Condition true/false check karke alag code chalane ke liye. React mein bhi conditional rendering isi soch par based hoti hai.

notes.question: Loop kis kaam aata hai?
notes.answer: Same kaam baar baar chalane ke liye — list print, count, items process. React lists aksar map se banti hain, lekin loops ka idea pehle clear hona chahiye.

notes.question: let kya hai?
notes.answer: Block-scoped variable jo baad mein reassign ho sakta hai. if/for ke { } ke bahar accessible nahi (us block ke andar declare ho to).

notes.question: const kya hai?
notes.answer: Block-scoped binding jisko dubara assign nahi kar sakte. Objects/arrays ke andar ki values change ho sakti hain, lekin variable ko naya value assign nahi karte.

notes.question: Interview tip: let vs const kab choose karein?
notes.answer: Default const use karo. Jab value genuinely change honi ho tab let. var almost avoid — function scope + hoisting confusion. React codebases mein yeh common style hai.

notes.question: return kya karta hai?
notes.answer: Function se value bahar bhejta hai aur function wahi ruk jata hai. React components bhi JSX return karte hain — yahi concept.

notes.question: Arrow function kya hai?
notes.answer: Functions likhne ka short modern syntax (ES6). React event handlers aur map callbacks mein bohat common. Short single-expression form mein return automatic hota hai.

notes.question: Arrow aur normal function mein basic farq?
notes.answer: Arrow functions ka apna this nahi hota — surrounding scope ka this use hota hai. Beginner level: syntax short + React mein handlers/map ke liye preferred. Class methods / special this cases mein normal function zaroori ho sakti hai.

notes.question: forEach kya karta hai?
notes.answer: Array ke har item par function chalata hai. Nayi array return nahi karta — side effect (print, push elsewhere) ke liye. UI list banane ke liye React mein map prefer karo.

notes.question: map kya karta hai?
notes.answer:
Har item ko transform karke NAYI array return karta hai. React lists ka core tool: users.map(user =>
  • ...
    • ).

notes.question: filter kya karta hai?
notes.answer: Condition true wale items ki NAYI array banata hai. Search, active users, incomplete todos — React UI filters mein common.

notes.question: reduce kya karta hai?
notes.answer: Poori array ko ek value mein fold karta hai — sum, count, object build. Pehle map/filter clear karo, phir reduce.

notes.question: Array destructuring kya hai?
notes.answer: Array se values nikal kar alag variables mein rakhna. React mein useState yahi pattern use karta hai: const [count, setCount] = useState(0).

notes.question: Object kya hota hai?
notes.answer: Key-value pairs ka collection. User profile, settings, API response — almost har real app mein objects aate hain. React props/state bhi aksar objects hote hain.

notes.question: Object destructuring kya hai?
notes.answer: Object se properties nikal kar variables banana. React components mein props destructuring bohat common hai.

notes.question: Object spread (...) kyun seekhein (React ke liye)?
notes.answer: State update mein naya object banana padta hai (mutate avoid). Spread se copy + override asaan hota hai.

notes.question: Destructuring kya hai?
notes.answer: Array ya object se values nikal kar alag variables mein rakhne ka short syntax. React mein props aur useState isi pe heavily depend karte hain.

notes.question: Array destructuring kaise kaam karti hai?
notes.answer: Position se values milti hain: pehla variable pehli index, doosra doosri. useState bhi yahi pattern use karta hai.

notes.question: Object destructuring kaise kaam karti hai?
notes.answer: Key ke naam se value nikalte ho (order matter nahi). React functional components mein props aise hi unpack karte hain.

notes.question: Destructuring mein rename kaise karein?
notes.answer: Object se nikalte waqt naya variable naam colon ke baad likho — jab key ka naam collide kare ya clear naam chahiye.

notes.question: Destructuring mein default value?
notes.answer: Agar value undefined ho to default lag jati hai. Props ke missing values handle karne mein useful.

notes.question: Rest (...) destructuring kya hai?
notes.answer: Bachi hui properties/items ek nayi object/array mein ikatthi. Wrappers mein kuch props nikal kar baqi forward karne ke liye common.

notes.question: Nested destructuring kya hai?
notes.answer: Andar wale object/array se seedha value nikalna. API response deep ho to kaam aata hai — pehle structure clear hona chahiye.

notes.question: React mein destructuring kyun zaroori hai?
notes.answer: 1) Props clean: function User({ name }) . 2) useState: const [x, setX] = useState() . 3) Event/object se fields jaldi nikalna. Interview + daily code dono mein bohat aata hai.

notes.question: Promise kya hai?
notes.answer: Future value ka placeholder — pending, fulfilled (success), ya rejected (error). API calls async hoti hain; Promise unka result baad mein handle karne deta hai.

notes.question: async / await kya hai?
notes.answer: Promises ko zyada readable likhne ka tareeqa. await Promise complete hone ka wait karta hai. React data fetching examples mein common.

notes.question: fetch kya karta hai?
notes.answer: Browser API jo server se data mangaati / bhejti hai. Response pehle Response object hoti hai; JSON ke liye .json() call karo. React mein usually useEffect ke andar fetch karte hain.

notes.question: React seekhne se pehle async kyun zaroori?
notes.answer: Almost har app API se data lati hai. Loading, success, error states samajhne ke liye Promise/fetch clear hona chahiye — phir useEffect + state se UI update easy lagti hai.

notes.question: Web Storage kya hai?
notes.answer: Browser mein key-value data save karne ka tareeqa — localStorage aur sessionStorage. Server pe nahi jata; same origin (protocol + domain + port) tak limited. Theme, form draft, login token (careful) jaisi client-side cheezein yahan rakhte hain.

notes.question: localStorage kya hai?
notes.answer: Data tab band / browser restart ke baad bhi rehta hai jab tak aap remove na karo ya user clear na kare. Persistent client storage — jaise dark mode preference ya saved cart draft.

notes.question: sessionStorage kya hai?
notes.answer: Data sirf us browser tab/window session tak rehta hai. Tab band hote hi clear. Multi-step form ke temporary steps ya tab-only UI state ke liye useful.

notes.question: localStorage vs sessionStorage — farq?
notes.answer: localStorage: persistent across tabs/restarts (same origin). sessionStorage: per-tab, tab close pe khatam; doosri tab share nahi karti. API almost same (setItem/getItem/removeItem/clear).

notes.question: Storage mein object seedha kyun nahi rakhte?
notes.answer: Dono sirf strings store karte hain. Object/array ke liye JSON.stringify likhte waqt, JSON.parse padhte waqt. Warna "[object Object]" milta hai.

notes.question: React mein localStorage kaise use karte hain?
notes.answer: Usually useState UI ke liye + useEffect se storage sync. Mount par read, change par write. Render ke during seedha storage mat likho — side effect hai.

notes.question: Storage ki limits / security tip?
notes.answer: Size limited (~5MB typical, browser pe depend). Sensitive passwords yahan mat rakho — JS se readable hai (XSS risk). Private data ke liye httpOnly cookies / proper auth better. QuotaExceedError possible.

notes.question: Interview tip: cookies vs Web Storage?
notes.answer: Cookies har request ke sath server ja sakti hain (size chhoti). local/sessionStorage sirf browser JS se access, auto request mein nahi jati. Client-only preferences → storage; server session auth → usually cookies/tokens carefully.

notes.question: React kya hai?
notes.answer: React ek JavaScript library hai jo UI (user interface) banane ke liye use hoti hai. Yeh Facebook/Meta ne banayi. Interview mein usually library kehte hain, full framework nahi.

notes.question: React library hai ya framework?
notes.answer: Officially library. Framework poori app structure aur routing/data rules force karta hai; React mainly UI layer deta hai. Routing, state management wagaira aap alag choose karte ho.

notes.question: SPA (Single Page Application) kya hota hai?
notes.answer: Ek hi HTML page load hoti hai, phir content JavaScript se update hota hai bina poori page refresh ke. React apps aksar SPA style mein banti hain.

notes.question: Virtual DOM kya hai?
notes.answer: Real DOM ka lightweight JavaScript representation. React pehle Virtual DOM mein changes compare (diff) karta hai, phir sirf zaroori real DOM updates apply karta hai — is se UI updates efficient rehti hain.

notes.question: Real DOM kya hai?
notes.answer: Browser ka actual Document Object Model — webpage ka tree structure (html, body, div, button...). Jab Real DOM change hota hai, browser layout/paint ka kaam karta hai, jo expensive ho sakta hai agar baar baar poora page update ho.

notes.question: Real DOM aur Virtual DOM mein farq?
notes.answer: Real DOM browser ka asli UI tree hai (slow/expensive updates). Virtual DOM memory mein JS objects ka tree hai (tez compare). React changes pehle Virtual DOM par sochta hai, diff nikalta hai, phir Real DOM mein sirf zaroori patches apply karta hai.

notes.question: React UI update ka short flow kya hai?
notes.answer: 1) State/props change. 2) Component dubara render → naya Virtual DOM (React elements). 3) Purane aur naye Virtual DOM ka diff (reconciliation). 4) Sirf changed parts Real DOM mein update. Isliye poori page rewrite avoid hoti hai.

notes.question: Virtual DOM se faida kya hai?
notes.answer: Direct Real DOM ko baar baar touch karna costly hai. Virtual DOM batching + diffing se unnecessary DOM work kam hoti hai. Note: Virtual DOM magic se hamesha fastest nahi — faida mostly smart minimal updates aur predictable UI model hai.

notes.question: Virtual DOM browser ka feature hai?
notes.answer: Nahi. Yeh React (ya similar libraries) ka concept hai — plain JavaScript objects. Browser sirf Real DOM samajhta hai; React Virtual DOM se decide karke Real DOM update karta hai.

notes.question: JSX kya hai?
notes.answer: JSX JavaScript ka syntax extension hai jisme HTML jaisa code JS ke andar likhte ho. Browser JSX seedha nahi samajhta; build tools (Babel/Vite) isay normal JavaScript function calls mein convert karte hain.
notes.syntax:
const element =

Hello React

;

notes.question: JSX ke peeche asal mein kya hota hai?
notes.answer: JSX compile hokar React.createElement(...) (ya modern JSX transform) ban jata hai. Yani JSX sirf readable syntax hai; asal output JavaScript objects (React elements) hain.

notes.question: JSX mein class kyun nahi, className kyun likhte hain?
notes.answer: HTML mein attribute class hai, lekin JavaScript mein class reserved keyword hai. Is liye JSX mein className use hota hai.
notes.syntax: Content

notes.question: Bundle / bundling kya hai?
notes.answer: Aapki kai JS/CSS files, imports, assets ko milakar browser-ready output banana. Production mein aksar chhote optimized files (bundles) bante hain taake app load ho sake. Bundler yeh packaging + transform kaam karta hai.

notes.question: React project mein bundler kyun chahiye?
notes.answer: Browser seedha JSX, kai modern imports, aur aapke source folders ko production HTML/JS ki tarah nahi chalata. Toolchain JSX transform, module resolve, minify, aur assets handle karti hai — Vite isi role mein common choice hai.

notes.question: Vite kya hai?
notes.answer: Modern frontend build tool / dev server. React apps ke liye popular starter (npm create vite). Development mein bohat tez start/HMR; production mein optimized build banata hai.
notes.syntax:
npm create vite@latest my-app -- --template react
cd my-app
npm install
npm run dev

notes.question: Vite mein dev aur build mein farq?
notes.answer: dev (npm run dev): local server, tez reload/HMR, source modules serve. build (npm run build): production output (usually dist/) — minify, optimized bundles, deploy ke liye files. Preview se built app locally check kar sakte ho.
notes.syntax:
npm run dev     # development server
npm run build   # production bundle → dist/
npm run preview # built files locally dekho

notes.question: HMR (Hot Module Replacement) kya hai?
notes.answer: Dev mode mein code change par poori page refresh ki bajaye sirf changed module update. Vite isay fast rakhta hai — React component edit karo to UI jaldi refresh sense milti hai.

notes.question: Vite React app ka short entry flow?
notes.answer: index.html → main.jsx/tsx → App component. Vite HTML ko entry point treat karta hai; JS modules import se load hote hain. Build ke baad yahi flow optimized files mein pack ho jata hai.

notes.question: Interview tip: bundle size kyun matter karti hai?
notes.answer: Bari JS download + parse slow first load deti hai. Code splitting, lazy routes, aur unused code hatana bundle halka rakhta hai. Vite/Rollup production build mein tree-shaking se dead code kam karne mein madad karti hai.

notes.question: CSS Module (*.module.css) kya hai?
notes.answer: Aisi CSS file jisme class names locally scoped hoti hain — build tool unhein unique names bana deta hai. React + Vite projects mein Button.module.css jaisi files common hain, taake do components ki .title class collide na kare.

notes.question: CSS Modules kyun use karte hain?
notes.answer: Global CSS mein same class name (jaise .card) kahin bhi clash kar sakti hai. Modules har file ki classes ko unique rakhte hain, styling component ke qareeb rehti hai, aur accidental override kam hota hai.

notes.question: module.css React mein kaise use karte hain?
notes.answer: File ko styles (ya koi naam) se import karo, phir className={styles.className}. String "btn" ki jagah object property use hoti hai.

notes.question: File ka naam *.module.css kyun hona chahiye?
notes.answer: Vite/CRA jaisi tools isi naming se pehchanti hain ke yeh CSS Module hai. Agar sirf styles.css likho to aksar global CSS treat hoti hai — classes scoped object mein nahi aatin.

notes.question: CSS mein .main-title ho to JS mein kaise likhein?
notes.answer: Dashed names ko bracket notation se lo, ya CSS mein camelCase likho. Dono theek; team style follow karo.

notes.question: Do module classes ek element pe kaise lagayein?
notes.answer: Template string ya join se dono styles combine karo. Libraries (clsx) optional hain; basic tareeqa yeh hai.
notes.syntax: Content

notes.question: CSS Module vs global CSS — short farq?
notes.answer: Global CSS: class names poori app mein share / clash possible. Module CSS: import ke through local classes, unique generated names. Reset/theme ke liye thodi global CSS normal hai; component styles ke liye modules behtar.

notes.question: Component kya hota hai?
notes.answer: Component UI ka reusable piece hai — jaise Button, Navbar, Card. Aik component return karta hai JSX, aur aap usay kai jagah use kar sakte ho.

notes.question: Functional component kya hai?
notes.answer: Ek normal JavaScript function jo JSX return kare. Aaj ki React mein yahi preferred style hai; hooks bhi inhi ke saath use hote hain.

notes.question: Component ka naam Capital letter se kyun hota hai?
notes.answer: React lowercase tags ko HTML elements samajhta hai (div, span). Capital name se React ko pata chalta hai yeh aapka custom component hai.

notes.question: Component composition kya hai?
notes.answer: Badi UI ko chhote components se jodna. Jaise Page = Header + Content + Footer. Inheritance ki jagah React composition prefer karta hai.

notes.question: children prop kya hota hai?
notes.answer: Jo content aap opening aur closing tag ke darmiyan likhte ho, woh children ke through milta hai. Wrappers/layouts ke liye useful hai.

notes.question: React mein wrapper kya hota hai?
notes.answer: Wrapper woh component (ya element) hai jo doosre content/components ko apne andar wrap karta hai — styling, layout, padding, border, auth check, ya shared behavior ke liye. Andar wala content aksar children se aata hai.

notes.question: Wrapper kyun use karte hain?
notes.answer: Common UI shell dubara likhne se bachne ke liye: Card, Modal, Layout, Container. Parent styling/structure ek jagah; andar different children pass kar sakte ho. Yeh composition ka practical use hai.

notes.question: Wrapper aur HOC mein short farq?
notes.answer: Rozmarra wrapper = children wala component jo UI wrap kare (Card/Layout). HOC (Higher-Order Component) = function jo component ley aur naya enhanced component return kare — zyada pattern/advanced. Beginners pehle children wrapper clear karein.

notes.question: Functional vs Class component — aaj kya prefer karein?
notes.answer: Aaj functional + hooks preferred hain (simple, shorter, official direction). Class components purane codebases mein milti hain (extends React.Component, this.state, lifecycle methods). Nayi learning functional se shuru karo.

notes.question: Component aur Element mein farq?
notes.answer: Component = function/class jo UI describe kare (blueprint). Element = us component/tag ka plain object result (<App /> ya <div />). React elements ko render karke Real DOM update karta hai.

notes.question: Components reuse kaise karte hain?
notes.answer: Ek baar banao, kai jagah import karke use karo. Different data props se pass karo taake same UI alag values ke sath dikhe — Button, Avatar, Card isi liye banate hain.

notes.question: Component chhota / focused kyun rakhein?
notes.answer: Ek component ka ek clear kaam (Single Responsibility). Chhote pieces test, reuse aur debug karna asaan hota hai. Bohat bari App file sab logic ke sath maintain mushkil ban jati hai.

notes.question: Component export/import kaise hota hai?
notes.answer: File se export karo, doosri file mein import. Default ya named export dono common hain; project mein ek style consistent rakho.

notes.question: Props kya hain?
notes.answer: Props (properties) parent se child component ko data bhejne ka tareeqa hain. Function arguments ki tarah socho.

notes.question: Props pass kaise karte hain?
notes.answer: Parent JSX mein attributes likho; child function unhein object ki tarah receive karta hai. Strings quotes mein, JS values curly braces {} mein.
notes.syntax:
<Profile
  name="Ali"
  age={22}
  active={true}
  onSave={handleSave}
/>

notes.question: Props ek object kyun kehlate hain?
notes.answer: React child ko ek props object deta hai jisme saari keys hoti hain. Destructuring se seedha name, age nikalte hain — warna props.name likhte.

notes.question: Props change kyun nahi karte?
notes.answer: Props read-only hote hain. Child unhein mutate nahi karta. Agar data change karna ho to parent state update karta hai aur nayi props bhejta hai.

notes.question: Props aur State mein farq?
notes.answer: Props bahar se aati hain (parent → child). State component ke andar ki changing data hoti hai. Props pass hoti hain; state useState (ya similar) se manage hoti hai.

notes.question: Props mein kaunsi values ja sakti hain?
notes.answer: String, number, boolean, array, object, function (callback), even JSX/components. Jo bhi JS expression braces mein likhoge woh prop ban sakti hai.
notes.syntax:
<List items={[1, 2, 3]} />
<Box style={{ padding: 8 }} />
<Button onClick={() => save()} />

notes.question: Boolean prop ka short syntax?
notes.answer: Agar prop true bhejni ho to sirf naam likhna kaafi — React usay true treat karta hai.
notes.syntax:
<Input disabled />
// same as
<Input disabled={true} />

notes.question: Callback props kyun use hote hain?
notes.answer: Child event parent ko bataye (button click, form submit). Parent function prop se bhejta hai; child call karta hai. Data flow parent → child props, events child → parent callbacks.

notes.question: Default prop value kaise set karein?
notes.answer: Modern functional components mein default parameters best aur clear tareeqa hain.

notes.question: Props spread (...) kab useful hai?
notes.answer: Kai props aage forward karne ke liye — wrappers/HOC jaisi jagah. Samajh ke use karo; unnecessary spread debugging mushkil bana sakta hai.

notes.question: React mein functions kahan-kahan use hote hain?
notes.answer: Functional component khud ek function hai. Iske andar event handlers, helpers, callbacks (props), aur map/filter callbacks bhi functions hote hain. Short: React UI mostly functions se banti hai.

notes.question: Functional component asal mein kya return karta hai?
notes.answer: Function JSX (React elements) return karta hai. React us return value ko UI banane ke liye use karta hai. Har render pe yeh function dubara chal sakta hai.

notes.question: Event handler function kaise likhte hain?
notes.answer: Click/change par chalne wala function banao aur onClick/onChange ko pass karo. Handler ko call mat karo jab tak event na ho — reference do.

notes.question: onClick={handleClick()} galat kyun hai?
notes.answer: Parentheses se function turant render ke waqt chal jata hai, click ka wait nahi karta. Sahi: onClick={handleClick} ya onClick={() => handleClick()}.

notes.question: Named handler vs inline arrow — kab kya?
notes.answer: Chhoti ek-line cheez: inline OK. Logic thodi lambi / reuse / readable: named function better. Interviews mein clarity zyada important hai.

notes.question: Helper function component ke andar rakhein ya bahar?
notes.answer: Agar helper ko props/state ki zarurat nahi (pure calculation/format) to bahar rakho — har render pe naya create nahi hota, test bhi asaan. Agar state/props use karni hon to andar ya unhein arguments do.

notes.question: Function ko prop ki tarah kyun bhejte hain?
notes.answer: Child UI event uthaye, parent decide kare kya karna hai (state update, API, navigation). Yeh upward communication ka common pattern hai.

notes.question: Component ke andar chhota function JSX return kar sakta hai?
notes.answer: Haan, lekin zyada tar better hai alag component bana lo. Kabhi-kabhi renderHelper() OK hai; agar UI piece reuse/complex ho to separate component clear rehta hai.

notes.question: State kya hai?
notes.answer: State woh data hai jo time ke sath change ho sakta hai aur UI ko re-render karta hai — jaise counter, form input, loading flag.

notes.question: useState kaise kaam karta hai?
notes.answer: useState current value aur updater function return karta hai. setX call karne par React component ko dubara render karta hai.

notes.question: setState mein previous value kab use karein?
notes.answer: Jab naya value purane value par depend kare — especially multiple updates ya async cases mein — functional update safer hai.
notes.syntax: setCount((prev) => prev + 1);

notes.question: State ko directly mutate kyun nahi karte?
notes.answer: Direct mutate se React change detect nahi kar sakta aur re-render miss ho sakti hai. Hamesha naya value / naya object / naya array set karo.

notes.question: Kab state use karein, kab props kaafi hain?
notes.answer: Agar data sirf display ke liye parent se aa raha hai → props. Agar component ke andar user interaction se data change hota hai → state.

notes.question: React events HTML se kaise different hain?
notes.answer: React mein events camelCase hote hain (onClick, onChange) aur handler ko function pass karte ho, string nahi.
notes.syntax: <button onClick={handleClick}>Save</button>

notes.question: Synthetic event kya hai?
notes.answer: React browsers ke native events ko wrap karke cross-browser consistent interface deta hai. Interview mein short jawab: React ka event wrapper for consistency.

notes.question: Controlled input kya hota hai?
notes.answer: Input ki value React state se control hoti hai. User type kare to onChange state update kare, aur value={state} se input sync rahe.

notes.question: Uncontrolled input kya hai?
notes.answer: Input ki value DOM khud rakhta hai; React usually ref se read karta hai. Simple cases mein theek, lekin forms ke liye controlled pattern zyada common aur predictable hai.

notes.question: Two-way binding kya hai?
notes.answer: UI aur data dono taraf sync: data change → UI update, aur user UI change kare → data update. Angular jaisi libraries mein yeh built-in hota hai; React mein officially one-way data flow hai.

notes.question: React mein two-way binding kaise banate hain?
notes.answer: Controlled component se: value={state} (data → UI) + onChange se setState (UI → data). Yeh “manual two-way binding” hai — React khud magic binding nahi karta.

notes.question: One-way vs two-way — React interview jawab?
notes.answer: React data flow one-way (parent → child props). Forms mein two-way feel controlled inputs se milti hai (state ↔ input). Child se parent update callback/props se hota hai, automatic bind nahi.

notes.question: React two-way ko explicit kyun rakhta hai?
notes.answer: Clear data ownership: state kahan hai, kaun update karta hai. Debugging asaan, unexpected auto-sync kam. Thoda zyada code (value + onChange) lekin predictable behavior.

notes.question: List of items kaise render karte hain?
notes.answer: Array.map se har item ka JSX return karte hain.

notes.question: key prop kyun zaroori hai?
notes.answer: key se React har list item ko uniquely identify karta hai taake add/remove/reorder par sahi DOM update ho. Bina stable key ke bugs aur performance issues aa sakte hain.

notes.question: Index ko key banana kab galat hai?
notes.answer: Agar list reorder, insert, ya delete hoti hai to index unstable hota hai — galat state mix-up ho sakti hai. Stable unique id best hai. Static list mein index sometimes acceptable, lekin prefer ids.

notes.question: Condition ke hisaab se UI kaise dikhayein?
notes.answer: Ternary, &&, ya early return se conditional rendering karte hain.
notes.syntax:
{isLoggedIn ? : } {error &&

{error}

}

notes.question: Kuch bhi na dikhana ho to kya return karein?
notes.answer: null return karo. React us case mein kuch render nahi karega.

notes.question: Hooks kya hain?
notes.answer: Hooks functions hain jo functional components ko state aur React features use karne dete hain. Common set: useState, useEffect, useRef, useContext, useReducer, useMemo, useCallback.

notes.question: Hooks kyun aaye (class se pehle kya problem thi)?
notes.answer: Class components mein state/lifecycle verbose tha (this, lifecycle mix). Hooks se functional components mein hi state, effects aur reuse (custom hooks) possible — code simple aur shareable.

notes.question: Rules of Hooks kya hain?
notes.answer: 1) Sirf React function components ya custom hooks ke top level par call karo. 2) Loops, conditions, nested functions ke andar hooks mat call karo. Order stable rehna chahiye.

notes.question: Interview mein commonly pooche jane wale hooks?
notes.answer: Must-know: useState, useEffect, useRef, useContext. Next level: useReducer, useMemo, useCallback. Custom hooks (useX) bhi poochte hain — khud ke reusable hook functions.

notes.question: useState kya karta hai?
notes.answer: Component ke andar local state rakhta hai. Value + setter milta hai; setter se update par re-render hota hai. Simple counters, inputs, toggles ke liye pehli choice.

notes.question: useEffect kya karta hai?
notes.answer: Side effects: API call, subscriptions, timers, document title. Render ke baad chalta hai. Dependencies se control hota hai kab dubara chale; cleanup return se leak roktee hai.

notes.question: useEffect dependency array ke 3 cases?
notes.answer: 1) [ ] — mount par ek dafa (+ cleanup on unmount). 2) [a, b] — jab a ya b change. 3) array skip — har render ke baad (usually avoid). Missing deps bugs ka common source hain.

notes.question: useRef kya karta hai?
notes.answer: 1) DOM node access (input.focus()). 2) Mutable value store jo change pe re-render na kare (previous value, timer id). .current property update hoti hai.

notes.question: useRef vs useState — kab kaunsa?
notes.answer: UI mein dikhani / change se re-render chahiye → useState. Sirf yaad rakhni hai / DOM handle, re-render nahi → useRef. Interval id aksar ref mein rakhte hain.

notes.question: useContext kya karta hai?
notes.answer: Context se value seedha read karta hai — beech ke components ko props pass kiye baghair (prop drilling kam). Theme, auth user, language jaisi shared values ke liye.

notes.question: useReducer kya karta hai?
notes.answer: State ko actions se update karne ka pattern (reducer function). Complex state / kai related updates / clear next-state rules ke liye useState se structured alternative.

notes.question: useState vs useReducer kab choose karein?
notes.answer: Simple 1–2 values → useState. State object complex, transitions kai types ki, ya next state purani state + action logic pe depend → useReducer zyada clear.

notes.question: useMemo kya karta hai?
notes.answer: Expensive calculation ka result cache karta hai. Dependencies same rahain to dubara calculate nahi. Har chhoti cheez pe mat lagao — tab jab measure/profile se cost clear ho.

notes.question: useCallback kya karta hai?
notes.answer: Function ki identity memoize karta hai (same deps pe same function reference). Child ko stable callback dena ho (React.memo) ya effect deps mein function ho to useful.

notes.question: useMemo vs useCallback farq?
notes.answer: useMemo → value/result cache. useCallback → function cache. useCallback(fn, deps) ≈ useMemo(() => fn, deps). Dono optimization tools hain, pehle sahi structure; premature memo avoid.

notes.question: Custom hook kya hota hai (short)?
notes.answer: Aapka function jiska naam use se start ho aur andar doosre hooks call kare — reusable logic (useForm, useFetch). UI share nahi, behavior/logic share.

notes.question: React mein data flow kaise hota hai?
notes.answer: One-way / downward: parent se child ko props milti hain. Child events/callbacks se parent ko inform karta hai ke state update ho.

notes.question: Lifting state up kya hai?
notes.answer: Jab do children ko same data share karna ho, state unke nearest common parent mein rakhte hain aur props/callbacks se share karte hain.

notes.question: Prop drilling kya hai?
notes.answer: Data ko kai layers ke through sirf pass-through props se bhejna. Deep trees mein Context ya state library se isay reduce kiya jata hai.

notes.question: Component kab re-render hota hai?
notes.answer: Jab uski state change ho, usko mili props change hon, ya parent re-render kare (unless memoized). Re-render ka matlab Virtual DOM compare + zaroori DOM update.

notes.question: List item pe wrong key se kya problem hoti hai?
notes.answer: React galat component instance reuse kar sakta hai — input values / local state swap dikhai de sakte hain. Stable unique keys important hain.

notes.question: Component ko pure kyun rakhein?
notes.answer: Same props/state pe same output. Render ke during side effects (API calls, random writes) mat karo — side effects useEffect mein rakho. Debugging aur predictable UI milti hai.

notes.question: React Fragment kis liye use hota hai?
notes.answer: Bina extra DOM node (div) add kiye multiple elements return karne ke liye.

notes.question: React Strict Mode kya karta hai?
notes.answer: Development mein potential problems highlight karta hai (jaise unsafe lifecycles, missing cleanup). Production UI behavior change nahi karta; extra checks mostly dev-only hain.
